signal: Treasure Data rebranded to Treasure AI and launched Treasure Code, an agentic AI CLI for CDP operations

email.subject1: a signal play for Treasure AI
email.body1:
Caroline, saw Treasure Data became Treasure AI and shipped Treasure Code, your agentic move into CDP operations.

Repositioning the whole platform usually means more strategic accounts in play than the team can cover before the new story lands everywhere. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Treasure AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Caroline, quick follow-up for Treasure AI.

A platform rebrand usually raises the strategic-sales target faster than the team can staff for. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to land the new positioning until the gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your strategic motion needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Caroline, last bit of proof for Treasure AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Treasure AI's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Caroline, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A full platform rebrand is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic-sales motion? I'll tailor it to Treasure AI either way.
